task: L6's positive check passed while its own negative control reported MISSED, so L6 proved nothing about the property it names: no family proven while the raster gate cannot be dispatched.

diagnosis.verdict: Two compounding causes, both confirmed by experiment rather than inferred. The check's only substantive clause became unfalsifiable, AND the mutation's subject stopped being a violation. Either alone would have produced the MISSED; both are present.

causeOne.shape: the check's condition is written so it can never be false
causeOne.detail: L6's promotion clause was `if (reach.presentOnDefaultBranch !== true && proven.length > 0)`. The raster workflow landed on the default branch, the queue's generator measures that with `git cat-file -e origin/main:<workflow>`, and RASTER_QUEUE.json has recorded presentOnDefaultBranch: true since commit a97e5d043 (2026-09-01, 'raster gate: record that the workflow is reachable and the first dispatch queued'; the infra merge is 3fa877b46 / #169). At a97e5d043~1 the same field read false. From that commit forward the guard is permanently false, so no promotion of any family could ever fail L6.
causeOne.evidence: Setting presentOnDefaultBranch back to false on the unmutated tree makes L6 FAIL immediately with 'observed: 85 famil(ies) are in a proven state while the raster workflow is undispatchable'. The clause was alive; nothing could reach it.

causeTwo.shape: the mutation's edit is not actually a violation of the property any more
causeTwo.detail: The case promoted `families.find(x => x.state === 'VERIFY_PENDING')` to COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN. That family is ar-misdemeanor-dwi-seal-set today, and it has held a complete-coverage RASTER_PASS with a receipt from run 33495068504 for some time. Promoting it is not false provenance at all.
causeTwo.evidence: Applied the mutation by hand and ran the plain verifier: 9/9 checks passed, LANE_CONTRACTS_HELD. Not only L6 - L4 did not fire either, because the family genuinely holds a hash-bound complete-coverage RASTER_PASS. The mutation had stopped being a mutation.
causeTwo.consequence: Fixing only the check would not have fixed the control. Fixing only the control would not have fixed the check.

shapesRuledOut.mutationEditsAFileTheCheckNoLongerReads: ruled out - L6 reads MASTER_QUEUE.json families and RASTER_QUEUE.json workflowReachability, and the mutation edited MASTER_QUEUE.json families; the file and field were right.
shapesRuledOut.checkReadsARecordThatNoLongerExists: ruled out - workflowReachability is present and well formed, and the second L6 case (dropping it) was and is DETECTED.

diagnosis.whyItMatters: L6 is the contract that refuses false provenance from the visual gate. Between 2026-09-01 and this change it reported ok while measuring nothing about any family's verdict.

theCheck: KEPT the original branch-wide clause verbatim: presentOnDefaultBranch !== true with any family proven is still a refusal. It is dormant while the workflow is on main, and it must stay so the contract survives the workflow being pulled from the default branch.
KEPT the clause requiring the recorded consequence to say what unreachability costs.

ADDED corroboration: a claim of presentOnDefaultBranch: true must be backed by at least one row carrying a receipt from a numbered run of the central raster workflow. Believing an unevidenced boolean in a data file is what silenced this check for a day; a reachability claim may no longer rest on its own assertion.

ADDED the per-family reading, which is the substance: every family in a proven state (PASS_COMPLETE, VERIFIED_PASS, LEGAL_REVIEW_READY, LEGAL_APPROVED, PRODUCT_PATH_PENDING, COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN) must have a row in the raster queue, and that row must carry a rasterReceipt that names the central raster workflow, names a numeric dispatched run id, returned RASTER_PASS, came from a job that concluded success, and is bound to the exact canonical SHA-256 the row pins.

whyThatShapeRatherThanTheAlternatives.notWeakenedOrDeleted: The check was not relaxed and the mutation was not removed. Nothing in L4, L9, PASS_COMPLETE, RASTER_PASS, source-binding, legal-input, claim, payment, sponsorship, participant-ownership or cross-tenant handling was touched.
whyThatShapeRatherThanTheAlternatives.notRedundantWithL4: L4's title says 'from the central workflow', but L4's implementation reads only the row's `currentRasterState === "RASTER_PASS"` string and its coverage object. It never opens rasterReceipt. A row that simply asserts the string with no receipt behind it satisfies L4 completely. Proven by experiment: deleting the rasterReceipt from ak-courtview-set's row leaves L4, L7, L8 and every other check green and fails L6 alone. The provenance of the verdict - which workflow, which run, which job, which bytes - is read nowhere else in the file, so L6 is not redundant; it supplies the half L4's title implies and its code does not check.
whyThatShapeRatherThanTheAlternatives.whyPerFamilyRatherThanBranchWide: A branch-wide reachability question has one answer and it is now yes. Once dispatching is possible, the only non-vacuous form of 'the gate could be dispatched for this family' is that it demonstrably was: a receipt from a run of it, bound to this family's bytes.
whyThatShapeRatherThanTheAlternatives.deliberatelyNotAsserted: Receipt-side coverage. Thirteen rows carry an older receipt shape with no documentsCovered / coversTheWholeFamily fields, five of them under proven families (ut_pet_dismissed_without_prejudice-set, ut_pet_limitations-set, ut_pet_no_charges-set, ut_pet_traffic-set, vt_seal_misdemeanor-set). Whether a verdict covers the whole family is L4's and L7's property, measured on the row, where all five declare complete coverage of a single assembled packet. Re-asserting it from a field the older receipts never carried would have failed five proven families over a schema drift rather than over anything about the gate. Reported here as an observation, not raised as a failure.

theMutations.repointed: The stale case 'a family proven while the raster gate cannot be dispatched' is replaced by 'a family proven while the queue records the raster gate as undispatchable' - it reconstructs the forbidden conjunction on the side that still varies, setting workflowReachability.presentOnDefaultBranch to false with 85 families proven. Same discipline as the earlier F29 and F13 repointings.
added: 'a proven family whose row carries no receipt from the raster gate is caught' - deletes rasterReceipt from the row of a proven family. This is the control for the property L4 is blind to.

'receipts attributed to a workflow other than the raster gate are caught' - repoints every receipt at another workflow file, exercising both the corroboration clause and the per-family workflow-identity clause.
theMutations.kept: 'dropping the reachability record is caught', unchanged.

doesAnyCurrentlyProvenFamilyNowFailL6.measured: 85 families are in a proven state (79 COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN, 6 VERIFIED_PASS). 85/85 have a raster-queue row; 85/85 carry a rasterReceipt naming .github/workflows/rcap-packet-raster-acceptance-batch.yml, a numeric workflowRunId (12 distinct runs), verdict RASTER_PASS, jobConclusion success, and boundToCanonicalSha256 equal to the row's canonicalPdfSha256. Zero problems.

auditOfTheOtherLaneContractsNegativeCont.question: Does any other contract pass while its mutation is missed, or carry no mutation case at all?
auditOfTheOtherLaneContractsNegativeCont.answer: No. L1 through L9 each carry at least one negative control, and every control other than L6's was DETECTED both before and after this change. L6 was the only ill one.

findingsReportedNotFixed.case: promoting a family whose raster verdict covers one of several documents is caught
findingsReportedNotFixed.observation: Its named subject no longer exists: zero rows have coverage.complete === false, so the case takes its documented fallback (a family with no passing row) and thereby duplicates the earlier L4 case 'a packet marked PASS_COMPLETE with no RASTER_PASS'. It is DETECTED, so the suite is not lying, but the partial-coverage property has no L4-side control right now.
findingsReportedNotFixed.whyLeftAlone: It is not the L6 illness - it fires. The property it names still has a live control at L7 ('a partial row claiming to cover the whole family is caught'), which constructs a partial row and confirms the refusal. Rewriting an L4 control is outside this assignment and would risk a conflicting edit to a file other agents are working in. If Captain wants it repointed, the one-file edit that works is: in RASTER_QUEUE.json set an already-proven family's row coverage.complete to false, which makes L4 fire on the proven-without-complete-coverage clause.

findingsReportedNotFixed.observation: One control (renaming the canary out of the workflow) covers one of its four clauses. The --negative-controls clause, the needs:canary dependency clause, and the 'source-conveyor is not running the packet canary' clause have no controls of their own.
findingsReportedNotFixed.whyLeftAlone: Under-covered is not the same illness as a missed control, and adding L5 controls is an expansion rather than a repointing. Recommended as follow-up work, not done here.

findingsReportedNotFixed.observation: Its check is currently vacuous on the tree (zero builders create a PDF without a fixed date), but its control correctly CONSTRUCTS its subject by removing a stamp from a builder that holds a receipt, so the negative control still fires. This is the healthy version of the shape that made L6 ill, and is noted as the pattern to copy.

Its control depends on finding a vf16 row with verdictClaimedByLane === 'PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT'. It fires today; it would silently report 'its subject does not exist' if that field were ever dropped. Fragile but not broken - noted only.

filesNotTouched: every packet, overlay, fixture, field map and build script
mutationHarnessWritesAreTransient: The mutation harness writes and restores MASTER_QUEUE.json, RASTER_QUEUE.json, vf16/rows.json and the other subject files in place. Every case reported restored, `git status` shows only verify-lane-contracts.mjs modified, and no data file is staged or committed.
grantsNothing: This return promotes nothing, opens no route and waives no gate. It restores a negative control that had stopped firing and gives L6 a property it can actually measure.
